Blancmange

Time: time
Servings: 2
Source: source
Tags: tested, sweet, dessert, vegetarian

Ingredients

  • 1/2 l milk
  • 40g cornstarch
  • 30g sugar
  • Any type of flavouring you want
  • Any type of garnish

Instructions

Whisk the starch in about 1/3 of milk, creating a slury.
Heat up the rest of the milk. Pour in the slurry, add the sugar and flavouring while stirring.
Keep stirring and heating until the mixture thickens.
It can be poured into molds and cooled completely in the fridge or eaten warm.
For example: You can add a spoon of cocoa or chopped chocolate and garnish with lady finger biscuits and compote.
